test_gtest_list_tests_flag: test the --gtest_list_tests flag to list all Google Test tests
test_gtest_list_tests_filter: test the --gtest_list_tests flag with --gtest_filter to list filtered tests
test_gtest_list_tests_default: test the default behavior of --gtest_list_tests flag when not set
test_gtest_list_tests_override: test that --gtest_list_tests overrides non-filter flags like --gtest_break_on_failure
run_gtest_list_tests_unittest: run gtest_list_tests_unittest_ with command line arguments and capture test output
